name: robot
scene_note: a turnaround, 54 frames at 1920x1080. All 33 elements, 25 library drawings and 54 poses are baked to plates/ - the scene is only needed to bake more.

render.note: the rig ships at 1920x1080; rendered at 4K so the crop can push in

layers.note: head is the dome, face plate, ears, eyes, lids and shine. Mouth_ (13) and Teeth (14) are left out and replaced by the drawn grille set - the rig has exactly one mouth drawing, so there is nothing to animate with. Neckpiece (20) and Drawing (21) sit in the collar and stay with the body.
layers.hands_note: Two independent Hand elements - 35 (10 poses) with Glove_Shadow 37, and 44 (9 poses) with Glove_Shadow 45. The only rig of the three that can gesture with one hand and not the other.

face.note: measured from the baked element plates, not by hand: face width is Robot_HEAD's bbox, centre_x and lip_line are the Mouth_ slot's. 83px from the slot to the bottom of the face plate, so max_mouth_height is 80.

eye_note: two blobs of one element (Eye_01), split by connected components on its plate. Flat green ovals with a black outline and no pupils, so gaze is impossible. Blinking squashes the eye inside its own box, which on a black-outlined eye reads as a shutter.

mouth_source.command: uv run face.py draw --style grille --out assets/rigs/robot/mouths
mouth_source.note: The robot has one mouth drawing, so nothing can be derived. Its mouth is not lips but a grille: an outlined slot holding pale-green bars the colour of its eyes. face.grille() opens the aperture and shrinks the teeth band, which is what a rigid jaw would do; the organic DRAWN_SPEC lips would read as a different character. Widths are set so each shape renders at the size it was drawn.

capability_note: 19 hand poses across two Hand elements (10 + 9) - the only real gesture library of the three rigs; all baked to plates/drawings. gaze is impossible: the eyes have no pupils. tears is false because a robot crying is a choice, not a default, and the cheek routing has not been measured.

poses.note: View angles baked from the turnaround as head/body plate pairs, with the mouth and eye geometry measured per pose by difference against the head plate. A pose marked lipsync:false has its mouth too foreshortened to animate - the rigs have no profile mouth.
